inlines.v: CORRIGIBLE, adjective [Latin , to correct.] 1. That may be set right, or amended; as a corrigible defect. 2. That may be reformed; as, the young man may be corrigible 3. Punishable; that may be chastised for correction. He was adjudged corrigible for abusive words.
